facts: Santa's postal code in Canada is H0H 0H0, and Canada Post answers his letters every year.
Toronto's Santa Claus Parade began in 1905, when Santa arrived by train and rode to Eaton's.
Rudolph was created in 1939 as a free booklet for Montgomery Ward shoppers.
A Charlie Brown Christmas first aired in 1965.
Every year, Nova Scotia sends Boston a giant Christmas tree to say thanks for its help after the 1917 Halifax Explosion.
Jingle Bells was played in space in 1965 by the Gemini 6 astronauts, on a harmonica and bells.
The 1966 Grinch special was narrated by Boris Karloff.
Reindeer and caribou are the same species.
Snowflakes almost always have six sides.
It's a Wonderful Life wasn't a hit when it came out in 1946. TV reruns made it a classic.
